import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/dogs_zurich.csv')

# Set style
plt.style.use('seaborn-v0_8-whitegrid')
sns.set_palette("husl")

# Create figure with subplots
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(20, 16))

# 1. Top 10 dog breeds by count
ax1 = plt.subplot(3, 3, 1)
breed_counts = df['Rasse1Text'].value_counts().head(10)
bars = ax1.barh(range(len(breed_counts)), breed_counts.values)
ax1.set_yticks(range(len(breed_counts)))
ax1.set_yticklabels(breed_counts.index, fontsize=9)
ax1.invert_yaxis()
ax1.set_xlabel('Number of Dogs', fontsize=10)
ax1.set_title('Top 10 Dog Breeds in Zurich', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
for i, (bar, count) in enumerate(zip(bars, breed_counts.values)):
    ax1.text(count + bar.get_width()*0.01, bar.get_y() + bar.get_height()/2, 
             f'{count:,}', va='center', fontsize=9)

# 2. Dog distribution by district
ax2 = plt.subplot(3, 3, 2)
district_counts = df['KreisLang'].value_counts().sort_index()
colors = plt.cm.tab20c(np.linspace(0, 1, len(district_counts)))
wedges, texts, autotexts = ax2.pie(district_counts.values, labels=district_counts.index, 
                                   colors=colors, autopct='%1.1f%%', startangle=90,
                                   textprops={'fontsize': 8})
ax2.set_title('Dog Distribution by District', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')

# 3. Dog age distribution
ax3 = plt.subplot(3, 3, 3)
age_order = df['AlterVHundLang'].dropna().unique()
age_order = sorted(age_order, key=lambda x: int(x.split('-')[0]) if '-' in x else 0)
age_counts = df['AlterVHundLang'].value_counts().reindex(age_order)
bars = ax3.bar(range(len(age_counts)), age_counts.values, color='skyblue')
ax3.set_xticks(range(len(age_counts)))
ax3.set_xticklabels(age_counts.index, rotation=45, ha='right', fontsize=8)
ax3.set_xlabel('Age Group', fontsize=10)
ax3.set_ylabel('Number of Dogs', fontsize=10)
ax3.set_title('Distribution of Dog Ages', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax3.tick_params(axis='x', which='major', pad=5)

# 4. Gender distribution of dogs
ax4 = plt.subplot(3, 3, 4)
gender_counts = df['SexHundLang'].value_counts()
colors_gender = ['#FF6B6B', '#4ECDC4']
wedges, texts, autotexts = ax4.pie(gender_counts.values, labels=gender_counts.index, 
                                    colors=colors_gender, autopct='%1.1f%%', startangle=90)
ax4.set_title('Dog Gender Distribution', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')

# 5. Dog registration trend over years
ax5 = plt.subplot(3, 3, 5)
year_counts = df['StichtagDatJahr'].value_counts().sort_index()
ax5.plot(year_counts.index, year_counts.values, marker='o', linewidth=2.5, markersize=8, 
         color='#2E86AB')
ax5.fill_between(year_counts.index, year_counts.values, alpha=0.3, color='#2E86AB')
ax5.set_xlabel('Year', fontsize=10)
ax5.set_ylabel('Number of Registrations', fontsize=10)
ax5.set_title('Dog Registration Trend (2015-2025)', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax5.grid(True, alpha=0.3)
for year, count in zip(year_counts.index, year_counts.values):
    ax5.text(year, count + max(year_counts.values)*0.02, f'{count:,}', 
             ha='center', fontsize=8)

# 6. Owner age distribution
ax6 = plt.subplot(3, 3, 6)
owner_age_order = df['AlterV10Lang'].dropna().unique()
owner_age_order = sorted(owner_age_order, key=lambda x: int(x.split('-')[0]) if '-' in x else 0)
owner_age_counts = df['AlterV10Lang'].value_counts().reindex(owner_age_order)
bars = ax6.bar(range(len(owner_age_counts)), owner_age_counts.values, color='#FF9F1C')
ax6.set_xticks(range(len(owner_age_counts)))
ax6.set_xticklabels(owner_age_counts.index, rotation=45, ha='right', fontsize=8)
ax6.set_xlabel('Owner Age Group', fontsize=10)
ax6.set_ylabel('Number of Owners', fontsize=10)
ax6.set_title('Dog Owner Age Distribution', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax6.tick_params(axis='x', which='major', pad=5)

# 7. Top 10 dog colors
ax7 = plt.subplot(3, 3, 7)
color_counts = df['HundefarbeText'].value_counts().head(10)
bars = ax7.barh(range(len(color_counts)), color_counts.values, color='#9B5DE5')
ax7.set_yticks(range(len(color_counts)))
ax7.set_yticklabels(color_counts.index, fontsize=9)
ax7.invert_yaxis()
ax7.set_xlabel('Number of Dogs', fontsize=10)
ax7.set_title('Top 10 Dog Colors', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
for i, (bar, count) in enumerate(zip(bars, color_counts.values)):
    ax7.text(count + bar.get_width()*0.01, bar.get_y() + bar.get_height()/2, 
             f'{count:,}', va='center', fontsize=9)

# 8. Mixed vs pure breed distribution
ax8 = plt.subplot(3, 3, 8)
df['BreedType'] = df['Rasse2Text'].apply(lambda x: 'Mixed Breed' if pd.notna(x) else 'Pure Breed')
breed_type_counts = df['BreedType'].value_counts()
colors_breed = ['#00BBF9', '#F15BB5']
wedges, texts, autotexts = ax8.pie(breed_type_counts.values, labels=breed_type_counts.index, 
                                    colors=colors_breed, autopct='%1.1f%%', startangle=90)
ax8.set_title('Mixed vs Pure Breed Distribution', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')

# 9. Dogs per owner (AnzHunde distribution)
ax9 = plt.subplot(3, 3, 9)
dogs_per_owner = df['AnzHunde'].value_counts().sort_index()
bars = ax9.bar(dogs_per_owner.index, dogs_per_owner.values, color='#00F5D4')
ax9.set_xlabel('Number of Dogs per Owner', fontsize=10)
ax9.set_ylabel('Number of Owners', fontsize=10)
ax9.set_title('Dogs per Owner Distribution', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
for i, (x, y) in enumerate(zip(dogs_per_owner.index, dogs_per_owner.values)):
    ax9.text(x, y + max(dogs_per_owner.values)*0.01, f'{y:,}', 
             ha='center', fontsize=9)
